title: V1 bookshelf MVVM implementation validation
user_prompt: Build a bookshelf page with book name, author, reading progress, favorite state, single and bulk favorite actions, progress updates, and a favorite count. Load data from rawfile JSON and separate Model, ViewModel, and View.
intent: Validate MVVM-01 with @Observed, @Track, an observed Array subclass, @State, @Link, @ObjectLink, ForEach, and stateless shared components.

must_cover: Use the V1 decorator set and do not mix V2 decorators.
Use ordinary Model classes for raw data and JSON loading.
Use @Observed and @Track ViewModels with toggleFavorite() and addReadingProgress().
Use an @Observed Array subclass for observable push and splice.
Keep ViewModel conversion and business logic out of the View.
Use @State for the page, @Link and @ObjectLink for business components, and ForEach for the list.
Use a stateless shared favorite-count component.
Do not import Model types into the View.
forbidden_patterns: Direct View access to Model types.
A getter in an @Observed V1 class with @Track properties.
Direct View data mutation instead of ViewModel methods.

runtime_assertions: The bookshelf loads from rawfile JSON.
Favorite and progress actions update the corresponding UI.
Bulk favorite uses two-way V1 binding.
Observable array mutations update the list.
The View does not access Model types.

title: V2 expense-record MVVM implementation validation
user_prompt: Build an expense-record page with totals, add and delete actions, rawfile JSON loading, PersistenceV2 restoration, computed totals, @Param read-only data, @Event callbacks, and Repeat rendering.
intent: Validate MVVM-02 with @ObservedV2, @Trace, @Computed, @Param, @Event, @Local, @Type, PersistenceV2.connect, and Repeat.

must_cover: Use only the V2 decorator set.
Use ordinary Model classes for raw data and JSON loading.
Use PersistenceV2.connect and load defaults only when persisted data is empty.
Use @Computed for totals, @Param and @Event for strict one-way data flow, and Repeat for the list.
Do not import Model types into the View.
forbidden_patterns: Direct ViewModel mutation from child Views.

runtime_assertions: Expense records load from rawfile JSON.
Computed totals update after additions and deletions.
The View does not access Model types.
